title: Executable Prefix Values for Locating Agent Failures
abstract: arXiv:2610.17633v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Work on debugging LLM agents treats the "first mistake" marked by a human or LLM judge as ground truth for where a trajectory failed. We ask whether such labels point at causes or symptoms, and make the distinction executable: we restart the agent from reconstructed intermediate states of a failed trajectory and estimate its prefix value V(h_t), the probability of success from each step, with a certified point of no return (PNR) for a failure. On 150 SWE-bench Verified tasks with two frozen open-weight agents, we build such curves for 47 and 60 failed trajectories and probe every step labeled by four frontier judges under the Traverse rubric. We find that the labels do not mark what a controller needs. Judges of different lineages agree on the exact step in only 21/57 cases, and the newest judges flag mistakes in 8/10 and 10/10 successful runs. For 66% of the labels, the agent's success probability does not drop at the labeled step; only

translated_title: 用于定位智能体失败的可执行前缀值
translated_abstract: 现有关于调试LLM智能体的工作将人类或LLM裁判标记的“第一个错误”视为轨迹失败位置的真值。我们追问这些标签指向的是原因还是症状，并将这一区分变得可执行：我们从失败轨迹重建的中间状态重启智能体，估计其前缀值 V(h_t)，即从每一步出发成功的概率，并为失败提供一个经过认证的“不可返回点”（PNR）。在150个SWE-bench Verified任务上，使用两个冻结参数的开源权重智能体，我们为47条和60条失败轨迹构建了这样的曲线，并探查了在Traverse评分标准下由四个前沿裁判标记的每一个步骤。我们发现这些标签并未标记出控制器真正需要的东西：不同谱系的裁判仅在21/57的情况下对确切的错误步骤达成一致，而最新的裁判在8/10和10/10的成功运行中也标记了错误。对于66%的标签，智能体的成功概率在标记步骤处并未下降……
tldr: 该论文提出从重建的中间状态重启智能体并估计每一步的前缀值（成功概率），以可执行的方式验证“第一个错误”标注究竟指向失败的原因还是症状，结果发现不同裁判的标注常常互相矛盾，且多数标注步骤处智能体的成功概率并未下降。
en_tdlr: This paper makes the distinction between causes and symptoms of agent failures executable by restarting agents from reconstructed intermediate states and estimating per-step prefix values V(h_t), finding that judge-labeled "first mistakes" often disagree across judges and rarely coincide with actual drops in success probability.
